notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: M1 (land animals), M2 (water mobs), M3 (night mobs) and W's w3 (the game events W's first merge left out). D0's d0b (silverfish in stone, endermites from pearls, flying navigation) is merged (c0366f3a), and release 6 is built with PROTOCOL 11 (789f6d23). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small (E3-0 names the few positional lists that are appended). Record decisions in the track log. LOAD: builds run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. Track E3 group blast-push: build track-e3.md section E3-7 group blast-push. Commits: 1. 'Blast Protection softens the push of Minecraft explosions': protection.rs reads minecraft:attributes explosion_knockback_resistance (add_value, linear, per worn piece, capped 0..1); Survival::blast_push scales a push by 1 - resistance; explosion pushes get their own list (PlayerOutputs.blast_pushes, ServerSim/Output blast_pushes; explosion_push, pvp-spared blasts and wind bursts feed it; the dragon, shield and ravager pushes stay in pushes); minecraft_players.rs applies blast_pushes through survival.blast_push. 2. 'MW2 grenades and rockets push Minecraft players like explosions': a vendored EntityWorld::blast_pushes (apply_explosion_by's player loop without the hurt, one shared helper) called from ServerSim::weapon_blast into blast_pushes; mobs keep MW2's own push. Anchors are as of 4301058a: re-check them after the e2b merge. No PROTOCOL bump, no comments, new fields next to related ones.

'Minecraft primed TNT is saved with its fuse and owner': vanilla PrimedTnt fields (fuse short, block_state TNT default, explosion_power only when not 4.0, owner UUID ints) in level_entity_tags/load_level_entity or siblings next to their calls; owner via player_uuid and a new EntityWorld::player_with_uuid; the unload retain also takes TNT; an owner who is not connected at load becomes None (log decision). Anchors are as of 4301058a: re-check them after the e2b merge (it edits end crystals and the dragon). No PROTOCOL bump, no comments.
